bilgiler.metin: ARC PULSE is a memecoin launchpad. Every token it launches gets its own collateral vault, and any holder can burn tokens into that vault at any time for a pro-rata share of everything the vault holds.
Every launched token has a fixed supply of 1,000,000,000 tokens and opens at a market value of 3,500 dollars.
A launch needs a first buy between 100 and 500 dollars and at least 20 dollars of collateral. The launch fee is 2 percent of the first buy.
The founder of a launch chooses a collateral tax between 1 and 5 percent. Every trade pays that tax into the token's own vault, so the vault grows as the token trades.

Every trade in a launch pool also pays a 2 percent fee: 0.30 percent to the founder, 0.30 percent to the developer fund, 0.50 percent to the liquidity vault, 0.20 percent to operations and 0.70 percent back into pool depth.

bilgiler.metin: In the first seconds after a pool opens, buys pay an anti-snipe tax that starts at 99 percent and falls by four every second, reaching zero after five seconds.

A founder can back a launch with any token that trades on the launch chain: paste the token's contract address, the app finds a Uniswap route, and the launch converts the collateral into that token inside the vault.
Local collateral launches are live on Arc, Robinhood Chain, Base, Arbitrum, BNB Chain, Avalanche and Monad.
On BNB Chain USDC has 18 decimals, so the launchpad takes pUSDC, a 6-decimal wrapper that holds USDC one to one and gives it back at any time.
Arc is the chain built by Circle where USDC is the gas token. On Arc the dollar a pool trades against and the gas a transaction pays are the same asset.
FTHM is the platform token of ARC PULSE. It has one market, its pool on Arc, and it can be bought and sold from other chains through LayerZero, with the price always set by the Arc pool.
FTHM moves between chains as a LayerZero token. Its route to Solana was proven with a real transfer from Arc to Solana and back.
Trades in launch pools go through an ownerless router that holds nothing between calls and reverts if the trader would receive less than the minimum they set.
PULSE GENESIS keeps its memory in a contract with the same address on every chain it runs on. Each chain's records are hash chained, and any chain can relay them to the others over LayerZero.
GENESIS-0 is a small byte-level trigram language model whose learning and text generation both run entirely on chain. It only learns from records that GENESIS accepted into memory.
GENESIS never moves user funds, cannot change collateral, vaults, redemption rights or bridge verification, and stores private conversations only as hashes.
